tweets.text:
A trade working out doesn’t mean the process was right.

And a trade not working out doesn’t mean it was wrong. Judging decisions by outcomes alone is how bad habits stay hidden.

This is why learning to trade in a bull market often leaves bad habits. Bad habits you need to get rid off asap when the market turns.

This is why that 2022 year was brutal on a lot of active traders.
